«A Song of degrees of David.» Behold, how good and how pleasant [it is] for brethren to dwell
Because the greatest part was against David, though some favoured him, yet when he was established king at length, they joined all together like brothers: and therefore he shows by these similarities the convenience of brotherly love. together in unity!

By Hermon and Zion he means the plentiful country about Jerusalem. Hermon, [and as the dew] that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for
Where there is such concord. there the LORD commanded the blessing, [even] life for evermore.
